title: A Echo for the Colony
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Silas Brightwater, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
